title: Rain Shadows
author: Ramya Rajan
problems: Row 3 "pass through to an ocean wave - robins by left in the center, partners by right on the sides" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
Row 5 "partners allemande right ½ and reform short wave with larks in the middle" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
The progression after row 7 "1st shadows do si do 1½ and end up facing shadow 2" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 10 "1st shadows pass by right shoulders back to partner" can't start from where the dancers are: pass by who must be one of partner, neighbor, larks, robins; got shadow.
Row 1 "circle left 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "balance right, then left" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 6 "balance right, then left" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.

Row 8 "2nd shadows allemande right ½ to form short wave with robins in the middle · ocean-wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Both ends would take the same end of the wave; the hands named do not fit how the dancers face.
Row 9 "balance right, then left" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
